svg.title: Its elements T(K, L) are alternating in K, L, kill the unit, commute with conjugation, preserve every lower filtered image, and intertwine simultaneous conjugation of K, L by orientation-preserving signed permutations with their action on labels. The reading for a separated tuple, labels vl, and K, L, is P lS(v1, . . . , T(K, L)vl, . . . , vn). The free internal Ward separation says the common kernel of these readings is zero at the required sufficiently large caps; lower caps follow by inclusion. Select finitely many readings by the same decreasing-kernel-dimension argument. Their joint map is injective.
